gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / capital allocation: already-selected VBB paper entries may deserve more notional when expected execution cost is lower, proxied by high dollar volume and contained signal-day range. This follows the playbook's free-data candidate-pool direction and avoids LLM/state-surface retunes.

2_history_check.accepted_vbb: exp-20260526-014 accepted the shared VBB paper adapter; exp-20260528-018 accepted breadth-intensity support; exp-20260528-022 accepted signal-day high-close support.
2_history_check.difference: This does not change VBB discovery, breadth thresholds, top-N, hold, exits, or live filters; it tests one new production-visible cost/liquidity capital allocation field.
2_history_check.nearby_failures: exp-20260527-905 rejected VCP cost/liquidity only because the EV lift narrowly missed its source-EV threshold; this run is VBB-specific and uses current accepted VBB trades.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; before=current accepted VBB adapter, after=best predeclared cost/liquidity support variant. Require positive aggregate EV/PnL, no EV/PnL-regressed window, >=10 adjusted trades across all windows, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, survival >=5%, and concentration inside guardrails.
